question: Can interpretable five-day ordinal progression, signed reversal, and curvature shapes form stable market-wide intraday trajectories after exact OLS5 slopes failed?
research_role: outcome-blind non-slope trajectory representation and redundancy compression only
usefulness_boundary: No supply exhaustion, demand strengthening, accumulation/distribution, support, acceptance, forecast, habitat, timing, or strategy claim is permitted.

inputs.source_adapter_contract: frozen required-scale MKT-MIN-001 exact PIT/session/reconciliation contract

ordinal_progression.primary: mean sign of four adjacent changes
neighbors: mean sign of all ten ordered day pairs
rank correlation of day order and values

signed_reversal.primary: opposite early-two-change and late-two-change mean signs, emitting late sign

neighbors: last adjacent change minus first adjacent change

forbidden_fields: precomputed signed_monotonic_fraction, slope_acceleration, and reversal_shape fields
strategy membership, signal, trade, fill, return outcome, MFE, MAE, exit, or outcome class

coordinates.absolute: raw non-slope operator value on median daily descriptor
coordinates.pit: causal expanding/trailing-756 percentile and robust z after 504 observations
coordinates.relative: same-date view minus ALL_A and rank across governed views
coordinates.aggregation_neighbors: same operator on daily p40 and p60 descriptor series

gates.no_rescue: A failed descriptor/operator is not replaced by a favorable definition, aggregation, view, year, endpoint, OLS field, or another descriptor.
